objective: Different connected parenthesizations of the same odd signed cycle yield checked linear-node unnamed resolution proofs by locally eliminating each interior triple while retaining only the shared inputs and the two endpoint triples in each summary.
status: Proved: Grouping the same strict pair checks into paths gives ordinary resolution proofs with linear numbers of nodes for every connected parenthesization, starting place and direction. Every local conclusion depends only on its two endpoints and the common bits.
title: Compose endpoint relations in ordinary resolution without product names
